documents.summary: TLPDC's official syllabus-statement page says instructors may permit, partially permit or prohibit generative AI, defines AI, bars AI grading, and sets conditions for requiring AI tools. It supplies a no-AI statement, a per-assignment statement and four AI Use Levels (0-3), plus sample faculty-disclosure and AI note-taking statements.
